::: {.callout-tip title="Plots are interactive!"}
-   **To zoom in and out, reset, or download the plot**, hover on the plot to see the option on the top right corner.
-   **To turn on and off data series**, click on the data series title in the legend located below each plot.
:::

```{r config}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false


library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(plotly)

colors <- list(
  ice_free  = '#d0e8f5',
  new_young = '#74b3d8',
  thin_FY   = '#2a7db5',
  medium_FY = '#1a5a8a',
  thick_FY  = '#0d3b5e',
  multiyear = '#051f30'
)

labels <- list(
  ice_free  = 'Ice Free',
  new_young = 'New/Young (<0.3m)',
  thin_FY   = 'Thin FY (0.3–0.7m)',
  medium_FY = 'Medium FY (0.7–1.2m)',
  thick_FY  = 'Thick FY (1.2–2.0m)',
  multiyear = 'Multi-year (>2.0m)'
)

cat_cols <- c('multiyear','thick_FY','medium_FY','thin_FY','new_young','ice_free')

```

## Eastern Bering

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="80%"}



```{r EasternBerinng}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

#############  Eastern Bering #############

region <- 'Eastern Bering'
total_area_km2_base <- 581894  # from Python computation at 12.5km resolution


############## SUMMER #############

# Load data
df_base <- read_csv('./data/EasternBering_sit_annual_oct.csv') |>
  mutate(
    time = as_datetime(time),
    year = as.character(year(time))
  )

# Build plot
fig <- plot_ly()

for (cat in cat_cols) {
  fig <- fig |> add_trace(
    x             = df_base$year,
    y             = df_base[[cat]],
    type          = 'scatter',
    mode          = 'lines',
    name          = labels[[cat]],
    line          = list(width=0.5, color=colors[[cat]]),
    fillcolor     = colors[[cat]],
    stackgroup    = 'one',
    hovertemplate = paste0(labels[[cat]], ': %{y:,.0f} km²<extra></extra>')
  )
}

#    line          = list(
#      width = 1.5,          # thicker stroke
#      color = 'white'       # white border between categories
#    ) 

fig <- fig |>
  layout(
    title = list(
      text    = paste0(region, ' — October Sea Ice Thickness (2011–2023)'),
      x       = 0.5,
      xanchor = 'center',
      y       = 0.98,          # push title to very top
      yanchor = 'top'
    ),
    xaxis = list(
      title      = 'Year',
      tickangle  = -45,
      rangeslider = list(visible = TRUE)   # slider at bottom
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title     = 'Area (km²)',
      range     = c(0, total_area_km2_base),
      showgrid  = TRUE,
      gridwidth = 0.5,
      gridcolor = 'lightgray'
    ),
    legend = list(
      orientation = 'h',
      yanchor     = 'bottom',
      y           = 1.08,
      xanchor     = 'left',
      x           = 0 # start from the left edge (coords)
    ),
    margin = list(l=80, t=120, b=90), #left, top, bottom
    hovermode = 'x unified',
    height    = NULL,
    autosize = TRUE,
    template  = 'plotly_white'
  )

#fig



############## WINTER #############

# Load data
df_base <- read_csv('./data/EasternBering_sit_annual_apr.csv') |>
  mutate(
    time = as_datetime(time),
    year = as.character(year(time))
  )

# Build plot
fig <- plot_ly()

for (cat in cat_cols) {
  fig <- fig |> add_trace(
    x             = df_base$year,
    y             = df_base[[cat]],
    type          = 'scatter',
    mode          = 'lines',
    name          = labels[[cat]],
    line          = list(width=0.5, color=colors[[cat]]),
    fillcolor     = colors[[cat]],
    stackgroup    = 'one',
    hovertemplate = paste0(labels[[cat]], ': %{y:,.0f} km²<extra></extra>')
  )
}

#    line          = list(
#      width = 1.5,          # thicker stroke
#      color = 'white'       # white border between categories
#    ) 

fig <- fig |>
  layout(
    title = list(
      text    = paste0(region, ' — April Sea Ice Thickness (2011–2023)'),
      x       = 0.5,
      xanchor = 'center',
      y       = 0.98,          # push title to very top
      yanchor = 'top'
    ),
    xaxis = list(
      title      = 'Year',
      tickangle  = -45,
      rangeslider = list(visible = TRUE)   # slider at bottom
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title     = 'Area (km²)',
      range     = c(0, total_area_km2_base),
      showgrid  = TRUE,
      gridwidth = 0.5,
      gridcolor = 'lightgray'
    ),
    legend = list(
      orientation = 'h',
      yanchor     = 'bottom',
      y           = 1.08,
      xanchor     = 'left',
      x           = 0 # start from the left edge (coords)
    ),
    margin = list(l=80, t=120, b=90), #left, top, bottom
    hovermode = 'x unified',
    height    = NULL,
    autosize = TRUE,
    template  = 'plotly_white'
  )

fig
```
